additional_info.subject: Case Note
additional_info.body:
Hello,
Is it possible to check charger 170002558? Today 14 of March a customer tried to charge at
07:39:10 a.m. (cu time) thru credit card, but she had a 0 recharge and she could not stop the recharge session.
On our portal we saw "Stop recharge denied". In fact we had to perform a reboot.
Thank you in advance.
software version
: v8.0.5-0-g33a6c1d+APN

Dear Mrs. Carusone,
I hope you are doing well. Thank you for contacting Technical Support team.
In you provided time frame we find out that the customer authenticated successfully.
Throughout the process I have seen that. The charger has full potential to have power delivery. But the EV never requested any power ( Always 0) please see below
And at 7:40 The charger rebooted:
Let me know do you have further question about the issue, please.
### As I have seen that from Iplanet S.P.A has lots of this types of issue(s). I have also checked that all the chargers are running with old version of FW. In my personal opinion. Can you please try to update the FW version? In order to avoid any bug issue. If you are unable to do it. Let us know we can also update from our end.
Waiting for your valuable response.
